unused_raw_material.description: ~4,000 additional Sentinel-2-only BigEarthNet-style patches (products T34UDG/2017-07-20 and T35ULA/2017-08-08), plus several single demo images (water2/3.jpg, farm1/3/4.jpg, built1.jpg, vqa1/3/4.jpg, cm1/2.png). Not used in data/demo/: the bulk patches are optical-only from different scenes (not a valid pair) and have no accompanying label file for BigEarthNet Q&A prep (Phase B2); farm1.jpg carries a DigitalGlobe watermark and was excluded per licensing risk; vqa1.jpg is an uncropped Google Earth Engine Code Editor screenshot. The rest have no confirmable source and were left in place rather than copied into data/demo/ to avoid scope creep beyond the 3 scenarios this phase needs.
